title: Lotus Nursery
goal: Keep the babies growing while the permanent pond is built.
summary: Establish three seed-grown lotus seedlings in the temporary nursery and keep the water gently moving while they mature.

shoppingList.estimateNote: The original Phase 1 estimate was recorded only as a total range of $60–100. Item-level estimates were not recorded before purchase, so they are intentionally left blank rather than reconstructed after the fact.

items.item: Aquatic soil, lotus pot, pea gravel and water conditioner

notes: The $30 Smartpond kit is appropriately sized for the small nursery, not the permanent pond.
Some algae in a small sunny nursery is normal; remove visible debris or string algae instead of repeatedly draining and restarting the container.
Keep only a few inches of water above the gravel while the seedlings are young so the leaves can readily reach the surface.
crossPhaseAccountingNote: The $30 Smartpond Filter Kit with Pump is physically used with the nursery but is accounted for under Phase 3 pump/filter equipment. It is not included in the $107.13 Phase 1 shopping total.

completionMemory.title: End of Phase 1
completionMemory.caption: Lotus nursery established and the seedlings are growing while the permanent pond is built.
